name: CognitionBioChem: A structural pharmacology workbench that reports a negative result
description: A structural pharmacology workbench for cognition-related CNS targets. Boltz-2 v2.2.1 runs locally and produced every predicted structure; every displayed value carries a provenance record. Eight studies were pre-registered under content hashes before any data was seen. The headline result is negative: designed peptides did not separate from composition-matched shuffles of their own amino acids.
